reference: NES284 board02, identical RTL in NES285 schedule

early_supply_preconditions.geometry: Actual checked geometry appears in the last SPI block for68/71, including restricted907 and all heavy7
early_supply_preconditions.raw: Unchanged ARM planner reads512 raw bytes before its first callback; dirty material precedes BG scratch reuse
early_supply_preconditions.H2: Current output ARM pre-scans terminal SEAL and reads finished material to build H2 before BEGIN
early_supply_preconditions.bounded_supply: Early E9 callbacks must not block indefinitely waiting for tile consumption that itself requires not-yet-produced H2/BEGIN and ordinary output commands
early_supply_preconditions.classification: The H2/callback cycle is a static integration constraint, not a newly observed RTL deadlock. Pre-recorded plan/material fixtures cannot serve as its proof.

rows.current: 84-bit NES-to-host mailbox plus host identity and validator epoch/serial/generation context
rows.replace: Use one immutable admitted identity for host header/ACK expectations and independent H2 identity comparison
rows.retain: Monotone serial, generation/bank, epoch binding, namespace after STOP/reset, final display retirement
rows.proof_needed: Mailbox received data cannot change before final display ACK and all consumers release; rejected/early next admission must not replace the comparison reference

rows.current: host header bytes, map descriptor fields, ordinary expansion/tap fields and receipt first/end calculation
rows.replace: One tagged descriptor lifetime with a shared checked end and operation-specific views; consume original compact payload once
rows.retain: Wire length/CRC, exact SNES original read order, output domain/alignment, actual DMA token/coverage and ordered ACK
rows.proof_needed: SPI enqueue, SNES asynchronous reads and CRC tap coexist; queue read port and held descriptor cannot be reclaimed on parser completion alone

rows.current: NES283 validator owns range end/cursor; NES282 manifest cursor/phase already derived from validator
rows.replace: Joint descriptor completion to RAM walk with one continuation instead of treating already shared cursor as another reclaim
rows.retain: Independent duplicate/domain/monotone-map checks, persistent validity vs current receipt, full cold map coverage
rows.proof_needed: Original physical read and ACK must precede receipt; range validation must not trust an ARM-provided acceptance bit

rows.current: Host captures original payload while validator computes provisional CRC; receipt waits for ordered ACK
rows.replace: One scheduled byte service may share combinational CRC work while retaining distinct live accumulators and tags
rows.retain: Provisional hash is not committed receipt; scroll freshness, retained raw CRC, H2 certificate/digest binding
rows.proof_needed: SPI request CRC and SNES byte capture may arrive concurrently; neither can silently lose a byte or assume unimplemented bus backpressure

rows.current: Two immutable 512B plan RAM banks, decoded held plan, tile source/cache, shared staging and token owner
rows.replace: Pending speculative plan admission must be distinct from COMMITTED tile execution and final display
rows.retain: Generation/epoch, bank write credits, physical ROM priority/response, STOP drain and token burn
rows.proof_needed: Actual284 rejects a sealed plan without lease; one decoded plan plus two pending RAM packets is possible only after a valid lease releases the first bank

rows.current: Manifest/H2 sealed then twelve exact display reads and token-bound final ACK across clock domains
rows.replace: Common completion owner may derive phase but must retain the terminal ACK boundary
rows.retain: Input COMMITTED != DMA completion != receipt != final visible display ACK
rows.proof_needed: STOP at every intermediate stage freezes writes and prevents stale final ACK or bank reuse

constraints.source_port: NES clock phase-RAM A remains source-owned until drain
constraints.output_port: host clock phase-RAM B remains receipt/H2 owner; new descriptor storage/arbitration is not free
constraints.wire: Original compressed E1/E9 retained unless a separately charged format change is justified
constraints.joint_gate: New matched whole Lite MAP plus retimed ARM/source/planner/IRQ/ROM/consumer schedule; no inclusive-parent subtraction or FIT seed search
constraints.implementation_status: No new host/validator RTL; exact old checks preserved. Area delta is zero, not an estimate for the proposed replacement.
